critique.evidence: The dark grid, restrained cyan/green/yellow accents, oversized headline, concentric vault illustration, and metric typography create a distinctive, cohesive security-lab aesthetic. The mobile card is especially well contained, and the desktop evidence panel has clear visual grouping. However, responsive composition is visibly broken: on desktop the horizontal navigation cuts through and obscures the headline, while on tablet it overlays the “What’s happening” content and clips navigation labels. Several technical labels and annotations are extremely small and low-contrast, and the tablet/mobile layouts become very tall with weak pacing between dense evidence blocks. These collisions prevent the screen from feeling demo-ready across all three viewports.
critique.fix: Rework the header/navigation so it occupies reserved layout space rather than overlaying hero content; use a compact menu or deliberate scroll rail on tablet. Establish responsive headline sizing and spacing per breakpoint, increase the minimum size/contrast of annotations, and tighten the mobile evidence stack with clearer section rhythm while preserving the strong vault graphic and accent-color system.
